summary: Agreement to sell vs stamp duty liability; possession retained as tenant, not under sale; Explanation I to Article 25, Bombay Stamp Act, 1958 applies only if possession transferred or agreed to be transferred under agreement; no deemed conveyance where possession contingent on future sale deed; stamp duty not leviable at agreement stage if possession not linked to agreement; impounding of document for deficit duty set aside.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; impugned orders of trial court and High Court setting aside impounding of agreement for stamp duty; agreement not deemed conveyance; stamp duty not leviable at agreement stage.
